notes: v0.21.7 (code 81): Major personal VRChat inbox overhaul with VRCX-compatible group, moderation and event classification, new Groups, Events and Other filters, group details, and matching Floating/Quest Mini VRCX group notifications. New Android high-priority invitation, request, friend, group and event channels support sound, vibration and heads-up alerts; pinned friend notifications also use a new high-priority channel. Settings includes a user-initiated test notification and Android channel shortcut. Optional explicitly enabled foreground WebSocket service connects directly to the VRChat pipeline for lower latency notifications while running, using ephemeral credentials without logging or persisting tokens; REST inbox refresh and 15-minute WorkManager catch-up remain, with exponential retry and live staff gating. Live stream is OFF by default and requires a visible ongoing notification; Android/device/network restrictions can still delay delivery. Keep existing invitation actions, local caches, GM1/GM4 group invite authority, phone/Quest tracking, OSC and permanent signing identity. Whats New shows five most recent patches v0.21.7 through v0.21.3.
